candidates.change_summary: Change burn to subtract from a different account's balance (owner) instead of msg.sender, altering totalSupply behavior when non-owner calls burn (but still guarded by onlyOwner).
Make burn reduce totalSupply twice (subtract _value two times), causing totalSupply to differ after burn completes.
Make burn not modify totalSupply (delete the decrement), so totalSupply remains unchanged after burn.
Change onlyOwner check function to require the opposite (msg.sender != owner), inverting access control so burn can be called only by non-owner, which changes who can reduce totalSupply.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier requirement by replacing the function signature so anyone can call burn, allowing non-owners to reduce balances and totalSupply.
Changed the effect so burn subtracts from the caller but increases totalSupply (a bug), causing differing balances/totalSupply after burn.
Modified burn to deduct from a fixed account (owner) instead of msg.sender, so calling burn can change owner balance rather than caller's.
Changed the require to check a different account (owner) for balance before burning msg.sender's tokens, allowing burns to proceed even if msg.sender lacks funds.
Changed owned() to always revert with the require message inverted, so the ownership check behavior is altered for callers that invoke owned() (though onlyOwner uses msg.sender==owner elsewhere).
